data.title: 爱西亚 · 晨光微曦的十指相扣圆满
data.description: 初升的金辉洒满纯白被褥，爱西亚整个人依偎在你的胸膛前。两人的十指在被单间紧紧交扣，少女眼角含着幸福圆满的晶莹泪花，甜甜微笑着感受这一刻宛如天堂的永恒安宁。
data.location: sun-drenched master bedroom with white linen curtains
data.action: nestled deeply under white cotton sheets with bare shoulders exposed, ten fingers tightly intertwined with partner, tearful ecstatic smile of pure matrimonial fulfillment
data.lighting: radiant golden morning sunbeams pouring across white bedsheets
data.mood: heavenly peace, holy matrimonial blessing, ultimate sweet surrender
data.promptProse: Nestled in morning bedsheets with bare flushed shoulders, Asia interlocks fingers with partner, crying tears of supreme matrimonial joy.
data.animaCaption: Asia Argento crying tears of sweet joy while holding hands in morning bed.
